Università della Svizzera italiana
Call for candidates to apply to the ERC Consolidator Grant 2027 call and the SNSF Starting Grants 2027:
The Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) welcomes excellent candidates who wish to apply to the ERC Consolidator Grants and to the career grants of the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF).
Application details

Internal deadline for submitting applications:

  • ERC Consolidator Grant 2027: 4 September 2026 (ERC deadline: 12 January 2027 (TBC));
  • SNSF Starting Grants 2027: 4 September 2026 (SNSF deadline: May 2027 (TBC)).
